result.title: Beyond Policy Discrepancy: Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
result.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance remains provided by the teachers. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and instruction following, CA-MOPD achieves an average score of 32.22, outperforming naive MOPD, Open-MOPD, and the merged initialization by 0.86, 0.83, and 0.74 points, respectively. Controlled comparisons further support the benefits of merged initialization and capability-gap guidance under matched training budgets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CA-MOPD：先把多个强化学习专家合并为学生初始化，再用 verifier 估计的教师—学生能力差距来调节各领域的蒸馏强度，能力差距缩小则减弱监督、学生能力回退则加强，同时保留 token 级密集指导，在数学、代码与指令遵循六个基准上取得小幅但稳定的提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按「已具备能力」而非行为差异分配监督强度的思路，可能为 LVR 中多源轨迹监督的贡献分配与监督权重随能力饱和而衰减提供可核查线索，但原文不涉及视觉输入与 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行验证。
